description:
Customer Acquisition Tools-B2C brings more than 280 marketing tools from NuSpark Marketing's AI Growth Accelerator into ChatGPT, built for brands that sell to consumers. Paul Mosenson, a marketer with more than 30 years in media, advertising and lead generation, built each tool to handle one job step by step.

Open a tool by name and it walks you through the work one question at a time, or you can attach documents about your brand to go faster. Tools cover planning and positioning, ad copy and promotions, AI search visibility, content and scripts, email and funnels, lead magnets, paid search and SEO, media planning, social media, and website and landing page improvements.

Not sure where to start? Browse the full list by category at nusparkmarketing.com/ai-growth-accelerator-b2c/, then type the tool's name in ChatGPT. For hands-on help, contact Paul through the website.

defaultPrompt: Need an AI Tool for Growth
